headline: Capitals place Pierre-Luc Dubois on injured reserve
take:
Daily Faceoff reports the Capitals have placed Pierre-Luc Dubois on injured reserve. Dubois has missed the last three games with an illness, and Jonny Brodzinski has been called up from AHL Hershey.

The absence stings because Dubois had been productive in a small sample. So far this season he has 1 goal and 3 assists in 4 games, with 0.96 expected goals against his 1 actual goal, so the scoring matches the chances he generates rather than running hot. At 5-on-5 he owns 60.48% of the expected goals while on the ice, and Washington's share of the chances is 13.8 percentage points better with him in the lineup. For a team at 47.6% of expected goals overall and 50% at 5-on-5, that is meaningful drive to lose. The Capitals sit at 4-3-0 with 8 points, and goalies have saved 5 goals more than expected, which has propped up the record. Without Dubois, the chance share could slip further. Fantasy owners should note the injured reserve stint and the unknown return date, while keeping in mind his usage of 17.1 minutes per game.
